description: The file defines the BasketService class, which implements basket-related operations such as adding items, deleting baskets, setting item quantities, and transferring baskets between anonymous and user accounts within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: BasketService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing shopping basket operations such as adding items, deleting baskets, updating item quantities, and transferring baskets.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's basket, creating a new basket if none exists, and updates the repository.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket asynchronously by its identifier, with null checking.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Updates the quantities of items in a basket based on provided dictionary, returning a Result indicating success or not found.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers basket items from an anonymous basket to a user-specific basket, creating the user basket if necessary, then deletes the anonymous basket.
